add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__)

spec2def(d3drm.dll d3drm.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# d3drm.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/d3drm-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(d3drm_shims OBJECT d3drm.c d3drm_main.c device.c face.c frame.c light.c material.c math.c meshbuilder.c texture.c viewport.c)
target_link_libraries(d3drm_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_canunload dxguid uuid libddraw libd3dxof libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(d3drm_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
set_wine_module(d3drm_shims)
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
    target_compile_options(d3drm_shims PRIVATE -Wno-incompatible-function-pointer-types)
endif()
add_dependencies(d3drm_shims wineheaders)
add_cargo_module(d3drm d3drm-cargo d3drm.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS d3drm_shims psdk uuid_sources)
